# Atishay Kasliwal

> Software and AI engineer in New York with 5+ years in production: distributed systems, LLM products, and the web interfaces on top of them. M.S. in Data Science, Stony Brook University (2026). Building Atriveo. Open to software engineering and AI/ML engineering roles.

Atishay spent three years at Accolite as a senior software engineer, shipping microservices for fintech, telecom and commerce clients that handled $1M+ in transactions for 100,000+ monthly users. Then came AI work. A research engineering role at Stony Brook built LLM services and the infrastructure behind them, and an AI engineering internship at Wake Forest's Center for Artificial Intelligence Research served medical-imaging models over 50,000+ scans. Most new work ships under Atriveo, a set of small live products for job seekers, health data and personal memory. Strongest in Python, Java and TypeScript, with merged open source work in Go and Rust.

Contact: katishay@gmail.com

## Skills

- Languages: Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, Go, Rust, C++. Go and Rust come from merged pull requests in Kiali, Red Hat mapt, NVIDIA NVKR, Numaflow and Mezmo Aura. C++ from InsureRaft, a Raft consensus log.
- Backend and APIs: FastAPI, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hono, REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, microservices, event-driven architecture, CQRS and event sourcing.
- Frontend: React, Next.js, SvelteKit, TypeScript, Chrome extensions, Expo.
- Databases and streaming: PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, TimescaleDB, Neo4j, SQLite, Kafka, Airflow, AWS SQS and SNS.
- Cloud and infrastructure: AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS), GCP, Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Firebase.
- CI/CD and observability: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Git, Prometheus, Grafana, Zipkin, ELK.
- AI and machine learning: LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, multi-agent systems, local models, PyTorch, scikit-learn, OpenAI GPT-4o, Whisper, Gemini, Pinecone, medical-imaging and radiomics pipelines, Bayesian modeling, Monte Carlo simulation.
- Distributed systems: Raft consensus with leader election and snapshots, replication and failover, caching, P99 latency tuning, idempotent event processing.
- Security: Spring Security, OAuth2, JWT, BCrypt, rate limiting, HIPAA-compliant data handling.
- AI-assisted development: Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex CLI, with security and vulnerability review built into the SDLC.

## Experience

- [Senior Software Engineer, Accolite (Aug 2021 to Aug 2024)](https://atishaykasliwal.com/experience/accolite/): 20+ production microservices across fintech, telecom and commerce, supporting $1M+ in transactions and 100,000+ monthly users at 99.9% uptime. Built a secure insurance data vault across 15+ providers and standardized CI/CD for 8 teams.
- [Software Engineer, Research, Stony Brook University (Nov 2024 to May 2026)](https://atishaykasliwal.com/experience/stony-brook-research/): Event-driven research infrastructure and production AI services. An async backend ingests 10,000+ FOMC intervals. LLM service changes cut inference timeouts by 80%, and DevOps work took one experiment loop from 6 hours to 90 seconds.
- [Artificial Intelligence Engineer, Wake Forest CAIR (May 2025 to Aug 2025)](https://atishaykasliwal.com/experience/wake-forest-cair/): Cloud-native PyTorch model serving on GCP with Terraform, across 50,000+ medical-imaging scans and 10 TB of data. Automated curation cut preprocessing from 4 hours to 18 minutes at 95% radiologist concordance.
- [Software Engineer Intern, Shriffle (Aug 2020 to May 2021)](https://atishaykasliwal.com/experience/shriffle/): Spring Boot billing services processing $50,000 a day, a real-time React operations dashboard that cut support tickets 30%, and test coverage raised to 99%.

## Scale and results

- Fidelity, through Accolite: an event-driven ETL pipeline in Java, Spring Boot, Kafka and Airflow ingesting 250K+ daily transactions from 10+ enterprise integrations into PostgreSQL.
- Accolite: reworked Redis caching and Elasticsearch layers for 100K+ users, cutting P99 latency 40% with zero Sev1 incidents across Jenkins deployments. Secured 10+ Fidelity microservices with Spring Security, OAuth2 and JWT.
- Stony Brook: a React, TypeScript and FastAPI platform that cut multi-model FOMC review from 30+ minutes to under 3 minutes for 2,000+ users. FastAPI microservices on DynamoDB serve structured financial data at 300 ms P99.
- Atriveo: 1,000+ active users and 2K+ daily queries at 99.9% uptime on Cloudflare Workers. The Chrome extension holds a 5.0-star rating and captures applications from 20+ ATS platforms. Ingestion processes 1K+ new job postings a day and filters out 75% of the noise.

## Live products

- [Atriveo Tracker](https://atishaykasliwal.com/projects/atriveo-tracker/): Job application tracking. A Chrome extension captures each application, and one dashboard covers referrals, assessments and trends. React, Hono, Postgres. Live at https://tracker.atriveo.com.
- [Atriveo Cortex](https://atishaykasliwal.com/projects/atriveo-cortex/): An AI working-memory layer on ScreenPipe that turns screen and audio history into projects, commitments and ideas, using a local model. TypeScript, Hono.
- [Atriveo Bio](https://atishaykasliwal.com/projects/atriveo-bio/): A wearable intelligence API that turns Apple Health data into an explainable readiness score, personal baselines and deep-work forecasts. TypeScript, Postgres, OpenAPI.
- [Atriveo Job Search](https://atishaykasliwal.com/projects/atriveo-job-search/): A self-hosted pipeline that scrapes LinkedIn, Greenhouse and Lever every hour, scores roles against a profile, and tailors a one-page resume with a local LLM. Python, TypeScript.
- [Chaal.tech](https://atishaykasliwal.com/projects/chaal-tech/): Multiplayer teen patti in the browser with no sign-up. One authoritative server per room on Cloudflare Durable Objects, eight rule sets, plus poker, blackjack and rummy. SvelteKit, WebSockets.

## Systems and research

- [InsureRaft](https://atishaykasliwal.com/projects/insureraft/): A replicated insurance event log on Raft in C++, with quorum writes, leader election, idempotent commands, snapshots and automatic failover.
- [Insurance Platform](https://atishaykasliwal.com/projects/insurance-platform/): Event-driven microservices moving policy data from third-party insurers to a payment gateway, using CQRS and event sourcing on Kafka and Elasticsearch. Spring Boot.
- [FedTalk](https://atishaykasliwal.com/projects/fedtalk/): Research on whether an LLM can predict short-horizon market reactions to FOMC statements, from transcripts, retrieved news and minute-level prices. GPT-4o, Whisper, Pinecone.
- [Atriaa](https://atishaykasliwal.com/projects/atriaa/): A multi-agent hospital command center that keeps watching ER patients after triage and flags anyone whose readings worsen, leaving priority calls to the nurse. Next.js, FastAPI, TimescaleDB, Gemini.
- [Kaggriculture](https://atishaykasliwal.com/projects/kaggriculture/): A research platform for a competitive farming-game economy: deterministic simulator, opponent modeling, planner search and replay analysis.
- [Bayesian Marketing Mix](https://atishaykasliwal.com/projects/bayesian-marketing-mix/): An end-to-end marketing mix model over 156 weeks with adstock, saturation, holdout validation, uncertainty simulation and budget allocation.
- [Atriveo Reel](https://atishaykasliwal.com/projects/atriveo-reel/): A self-hosted editor that turns two clips into a vertical comparison reel, with durable background rendering. Next.js, FFmpeg, Remotion.
- [Medscan](https://atishaykasliwal.com/projects/medscan/): A proof of concept connecting health and billing data into plain answers about visits and costs, on synthetic data only. Python, PostgreSQL, Neo4j.

Merged pull requests in projects run by other teams, as of November 2026:

- [Keycloak](https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged+author%3Aatishay-kasliwal): Named the masthead options toggle shown on narrow screens.
- [Kiali](https://github.com/kiali/kiali/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged+author%3Aatishay-kasliwal): Bounded kube cache reads with a timeout so a lost cluster can't block a read forever.
- [Cockpit](https://github.com/cockpit-project/cockpit/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged+author%3Aatishay-kasliwal): 2 merged, including making the terminal scrollbar visible again.

- [Red Hat mapt](https://github.com/redhat-developer/mapt/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged+author%3Aatishay-kasliwal): 4 merged, including a fix for password aging locking users out of SSH on IBM Cloud.
- [Mezmo Aura](https://github.com/mezmo/aura/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged+author%3Aatishay-kasliwal): 9 merged in a Rust SRE agent platform.

- [PR-Agent](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged+author%3Aatishay-kasliwal): Recorded which config keys PR comments can override.
